description: We are a group of 20 undergrad and graduate students building a Rube Goldberg Machine to compete in the National Rube Goldberg Machine Competition hosted at Purdue University. Through creating the machine, members experience iterative design techniques in a creative environment. Members also have the opportunity to engage in community education in teaching simple machines and basic chain reactions to local elementary schoolers.

name: Rural Area Student Initiative
description: RASI exists to extend resources to rural high school students that are interested in pursuing higher education. In addition, RASI serves as a space for rural college students to support one another as they adjust to the university environment.

name: Russian Speaking Organization
description: Russian Speaking Organization serves as the union for Russian speakers on campus. Our goal is to bring awareness to Russian-speaking countries’ culture, history and traditions, and to form a community for Russian native speakers and those who are learning or interested in learning Russian.

name: SAE Aero @ Illinois
description: The mission of SAE Aero @ Illinois is to provide students at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign with a collaborative and educational environment to develop real-world engineering skills related to the aerospace sector through hands-on engineering, business, and leadership experiences. The organization aims to bring in a diverse group of students to design, construct, and test large scale remote-controlled and autonomous aircraft to compete in the annual SAE Aero Design competition sponsored by the Society of Automotive Engineers.

name: Salaam Middle East & North Africa (MENA) Cultural Center
description: The mission and vision of the Salaam Middle East & North Africa (MENA) Cultural Center are to provide a home for a border-fluid MENA community and to inspire holistic student success, inclusion, and belonging. By fostering the development of critical, intercultural citizens and global leaders who are better equipped to read and engage our complex and nuanced world, we hope to leave our communities better places than we found them.

name: Saudi Students Association
description: The Saudi Students Association (SSA) at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign is dedicated to creating a welcoming community that celebrates Saudi culture, supports Saudi students, and fosters crosscultural understanding. We aim to represent and advocate for Saudi students on campus, provide social, cultural, and academic support, and organize events that promote Saudi heritage and traditions. Our goal is to build bridges between Saudi students and the wider university community, while inspiring leadership, service, and unity among our members. Through our activities, we strive to create

name: Scandinavian Club
description: Scan club serves as a way for University of Illinois students to engage with Scandinavian culture and identity through interacting with various traditions, foods, film, as well as language. The club is open to those with family ties to Scandinavia, native speakers, or those who are hoping to learn more about the culture. All are welcome! Visit the resource tab and follow “Useful Links” to find our GroupMe and Instagram!

name: Science Olympiad at Illinois
description: Science Olympiad at Illinois (SOIL) is a student-run organization with the purpose of supporting the Science Olympiad experience for high school students in Urbana-Champaign and the state of Illinois. We strive to include Science Olympiad alumni and students who are interested in supporting Science Olympiad, regardless of personal identity or views. To maintain a strong connection with the Science Olympiad community, our goals are to host a Science Olympiad invitational competition and to provide outreach to current Science Olympiad Division B teams, Division C teams, and with Illinois Science

name: Scouting Illini
description: The purpose of Scouting Illini is to foster a fellowship-based service community dedicated to serving others in the Champaign-Urbana community and promoting the timeless values of Scouting America (Boy Scouts of America).

name: Scrapbooking Club
description: The Scrapbooking Club serves to provide a welcoming community for people with a creative mind, where they can express themselves through art forms of journaling, scrapbooking, and zines. We explore various art concepts and techniques in-depth, and put them into practice by creating and sharing artwork that transmit our artistic identity.

name: Security Studies Group
description: The Security Studies Group aims to provide members with unique opportunities to learn more about global security issues, from nuclear non-proliferation to geopolitical conflicts. The Security Studies Group engages in career prep, guest speakers, simulations, restricted networking events, and social events to name a few. The group and its events have proved useful and popular across a variety of majors; for individuals interested in intelligence, diplomacy, academia, or policy.

name: Serbian Student Association
description: The Serbian Student Association is a cultural organization that serves as an inclusive community for native Serbian speakers, students with Serbian heritage, and individuals interested in Serbian culture and language. The SSA’s mission also stands to bring awareness of Serbian culture, traditions, and history in the United States to the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

name: Service Oriented Aerial Robotics
description: Designing and manufacturing UAVs for the purpose of philanthropic service to the environment and society. As a RSO we are dedicated to exploring the many applications of UAVs and evaluating their efficiency at completing tasks and addressing the issues they are designed to solve. By making use of team-based systems, we provide members with the creative freedom to grow through experimentation.

name: SGI Buddhists for World Peace
description: SGI Buddhists for World Peace (SGI-BWP) serves as the place for the students who want to study Nichiren Buddhism and learn the philosophy of Buddhist philosopher, peace-builder, educator, and writer, Daisaku Ikeda, who has received 408 academic honors as of 2025. The fundamental purpose of the SGI-BWP is to help students unlock their hidden potential and achieve creative harmony with their environment through the philosophy and practice of Nichiren Buddhism in the SGI-USA. This is the ultimate expression of individual empowerment – that each student can transform the inevitable challenges of d

name: Sharing Smiles with Hospice Patients
description: Sharing Smiles with Hospice Patients UIUC has three main goals: 1) To function as a support system for students currently involved with hospice volunteering by building community on our campus. 2) To educate our student body by fostering a safe and welcoming environment for students of all majors to learn about hospice and palliative care. 3) To help support volunteers and their hospice patients by making cards/crafts for patients, and by filming legacy videos for them to preserve their stories.

name: She's the First UIUC
description: This student organization raises funds and awareness for girls' education in low-income countries across the globe. Proceeds are sent directly to the national She’s the First organization at the end of each school year.

name: Sibshops UIUC
description: The Sibshops UIUC serves as a program and movement designed to support the siblings of individuals with special needs or disabilities. The mission of Sibshops is to create a safe and supportive space where these siblings, often referred to as "sibs," can come together to connect with others who share similar experiences, gain information and insights, and build essential life skills. The goals of a Sibshops UIUC is to provide support, education, connection, skill-building, fun and advocacy to the Champaign-Urbana community.

name: Sigma Alpha Epsilon Fraternity
description: The mission of Sigma Alpha Epsilon is to promote the highest standards of friendship, scholarship, and service by our members based upon the ideals set forth by our Founders and as specifically enunciated in "The True Gentleman."

name: Sigma Alpha Iota International Music Fraternity for Women
description: THE MISSION OF Sigma Alpha Iota International Music Fraternity IS TO ENCOURAGE, NURTURE, AND SUPPORT THE ART OF MUSIC.

name: Sigma Alpha Mu Fraternity
description: To foster and maintain among its sons a spirit of fraternity, a spirit of mutual moral aid and support; to instill and maintain in the hearts of its sons love for and loyalty to Alma Mater and its ideals; to inculcate among its sons such ideals as will result in actions worthy of the highest precepts of true manhood, democracy, and humanity.

name: Sigma Alpha Professional Agricultural Sorority
description: The objective of this sorority shall be to promote its members in all facets of agriculture and to strengthen the bonds of friendship among them. It is the purpose of its members to strive for achievement in scholarship, leadership, and service, and to further the development of excellence in women pursuing careers in agriculture.

name: Sigma Beta Rho Fraternity, Inc.
description: To share the three pillars of Society, Brotherhood, and Remembrance to its members and the general community. Together we also strive to establish a nationwide network that was envisioned by our founding fathers. Through the years, we have carried our ideals of Society, Brotherhood, and Remembrance beyond our original objectives. We accept individuals of all cultures, backgrounds, and beliefs and promote diversity within our organization. It is our belief that these three pillars help to create strong leaders for the community.

name: Sigma Chi Fraternity
description: To foster a brotherhood of transformational leaders through friendship, justice, and learning.

name: Sigma Delta Tau
description: Sigma Delta Tau’s mission is to empower each member to reach her fullest potential by enriching the experience of women with similar ideals, building lasting relationships, promoting civic responsibility, and fostering personal growth.

name: Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Inc.
description: The purpose of the Delta Rho Chapter is to enhance the quality of life for women and their families in the U.S. and globally through community service, civil, and social action. Our goal is to achieve greater progress in the areas of education, health awareness, and leadership development. Our members, affiliates, staff, and community partners work to create and support initiatives that align with our vision.

name: Sigma Lambda Beta International Fraternity Inc.-Kappa Chapter
description: The purpose of this Chapter shall be primarily one of promoting Latino/Hispanic culture and standards of excellence in morality, ethics, and education. Further, the Chapter shall work to better serve the needs and wants of all people by disseminating the rich culture which we all share. Finally, the Chapter shall maintain respect for the views of others, so that through this tolerance we shall enhance our understanding of one another and better our community, our country, and the world

name: Sigma Lambda Gamma National Sorority Inc. Delta Chapter
description: Through excellence in the organization’s five founding principles, Sigma Lambda Gamma provides opportunities for lifelong empowerment to its members, thereby positively influencing the global community.

name: Sigma Nu Fraternity
description: To create an engaging social environment for young men of similar values.

name: Sigma Phi Delta Fraternity
description: Sigma Phi Delta is a social professional engineering fraternity dedicated to the advancement of the engineering profession and all engineers within our organization. We admit membership to individuals pursuing a degree in an engineering or engineering adjacent discipline. We are social in that we operate in the manner of a social fraternity, with a chapter house on campus, philanthropy events, intramural sports activities, and a close bond to our large alumni network. These efforts build and foster a deep rooted sense of brotherhood that will exist long beyond our college years. We are profess

name: Sigma Phi Epsilon
description: We envision a new generation of men who lead with purpose and strong personal values, develop a sound mind and sound body through healthy, disciplined habits, and fulfill their potential through lifelong relationships.

name: Sigma Psi Zeta Sorority, Inc.
description: Sigma Psi Zeta Sorority, Inc. is a progressive, multicultural Greek Organization that provides a means to success and support for women, particularly women of color. We build on the unity of strong and independent leaders to affect change in our organization, our campuses, and our local communities.

name: Sikh Student Association
description: Sikh Student Association serves as the student organization whose purpose is to make known on campus aspects of Sikh and Punjabi culture, and to provide a safe place for support and socialization to currently attending and alumni students of UIUC.

name: Silicon Valley Without Borders
description: Silicon Valley Without Borders, formerly the International Consulting Network (ICON), enhances collaboration between Illinois students and global technology clusters through international consulting projects, networking opportunities, and professional development. Students work in international teams to create innovative solutions for clients, culminating in an immersion trip and presentation to tech leaders in countries across the world, ranging from Switzerland and Sweden to New York and South Korea.

name: Singapore Students Association
description: UIUCSSA, a Registered Student Organization (RSO) of the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC), is committed to fostering and maintaining a familiar community on campus for all Singaporeans and partners at UIUC. The RSO is also committed to reaching out to the broader community at UIUC, promoting awareness of Singaporean culture and opportunities.

name: SKATE for Girls
description: SKATE for Girls Illinois serves as a platform to empower young women through the integration of figure skating and STEM education, with a focus on mathematics. Our mission is to provide students with the opportunity to develop both athletic and academic skills in a supportive and inclusive environment. We run weekly programs that include skating lessons, tutoring sessions, and mentoring opportunities for middle school students. We aim to inspire confidence, foster leadership, and promote the pursuit of STEM fields among girls on campus and in the community. By offering mentorship, tutoring, an

name: Skateboarding Illini
description: The Skateboarding Illini RSO aims to promote a sense of community and acceptance among university students who seek to explore the sport and culture of skateboarding through self-expression, self-improvement, and community involvement.

name: SKY Meditation at UIUC
description: Bringing meditation, breathwork, emotional intelligence, social connection, and service leadership to UIUC students, faculty and staff.

name: Snacks of the World
description: Snacks of the World will offer students at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign the opportunity to taste and learn more about different snack foods from various parts of the world.

name: Social Gaming Club
description: To maintain a friendly, welcoming environment for casual and competitive gamers in order to create and improve interpersonal connections. To enjoy all kinds of games, events, and activities together emphasizing good sportsmanship and mutual respect.

name: Social Justice Initiative
description: The Social Justice Initiative serves to expand our collective knowledge and understanding of the importance of social justice while sharing this need with our community and school with the overall intent to increase social justice education. We aspire to increase students’ critical awareness around structural systems of oppression, and actively promote equality and equity for everyone in society using Human-Centered Design (HCD) through workshops, collaborative community projects, and guest speakers.

name: Society for Business Management in Architecture
description: The primary goal of the Society of Business Management in Architecture (SBMA) is to inform and educate architecture students about the large array of opportunities available to them in the fields of construction management, development, entrepreneurial thought, firm management, law, and real estate. It will then be the goal of the organization to help develop students into future business leaders. SBMA accomplishes these goals through the continual provision of forums for collaboration and various events. Many students will be interfacing with the business world; therefore, it is key we have a

name: Society for Engineering Mechanics
description: The Society for Engineering Mechanics (SEM) provides a community for UIUC students majoring in Engineering Mechanics (EM) or pursuing graduate degrees in Theoretical and Applied Mechanics (TAM). Members collaborate and build projects to gain design experience and attend events to form and develop social, departmental, and professional ties. SEM collaborates with faculty to improve TAM courses and hosts social events for students and faculty to get to know each other.

name: Society for Equity in Astronomy
description: The Society for Equity in Astronomy (SEA) strives to promote equity and inclusion locally in Astronomy and related fields. We work to maintain a safe space environment, where members can feel free to talk about any problems they are having and explore the progression toward a more diverse and welcoming astronomy community.

name: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics
description: To advance the application of mathematics and computational science to engineering, industry, science, and society. To promote research that will lead to effective new mathematical and computational methods and techniques for science, engineering, industry, and society. To provide media for the exchange of information and ideas among mathematicians, engineers, and scientists.

name: Society for the Advancement of Chicanos and Native Americans in Science - UIUC Chapter
description: There is a future where STEM reflects the demographics of our country, so the field is better equipped to solve our world's most pressing problems. Through our people, programs, and partnerships, SACNAS has taken a radical approach to lead with culture and identity as the means to achieve true diversity in STEM.

name: Society for the Advancement of Material and Process Engineering UIUC Chapter
description: The SAMPE UIUC RSO serves as to advance the materials and process engineering community through providing enhanced educational opportunities and establishing undergraduate/graduate student community at UIUC.

name: Society for the Promotion of Indian Classical Music and Culture Amongst Youth
description: SPICMACAY Illinois is a chapter of the international SPICMACAY movement, with the goal of promoting Indian cultural heritage, including music, dance, and other arts. SPICMACAY Illinois's mission is to organize jam sessions, performances, and other events to connect, promote, and practice Indian classical music and dance among the UIUC community.

name: Society for Women in Physics
description: Society for Women in Physics serves as the social and professional network among female and other gender minority students, and their allies in the physics department in order to empower them throughout their career. SWIP also provides opportunities for its members to interact with other physics students, faculty, and the community in social, academic and philanthropic events.

name: Society of American Archivists
description: SAA student chapter at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) empowers its members to understand humanity’s past through ethically-based scientific and humanistic investigation, to promote preservation of archaeological resources and cultural heritage through support of legislation and education, to create collaboration between the profession and descendant communities, and to assist professional growth.

name: Society of Architectural Historians: Ricker Chapter
description: The Society of Architectural Historians: Ricker Chapter serves to create educational opportunities for all students at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign to deepen their knowledge and appreciation for architecture, landscape history, and historic preservation.

name: Society of Asian Scientists and Engineers
description: The Society of Asian Scientists and Engineers (SASE) is dedicated to helping Asian and Asian-American Students unlock their full potential through career, professional, and social development while celebrating APIDA culture.

name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
description: A) Maintain and increase the enrollment of Hispanics and other minorities in engineering and science programs at UIUC. B) Provide information to Hispanic and other minorities at all grade levels concerning programs available in engineering and science. C) Provide academic guidance, access to academic resources, leadership opportunities, career development, and career orientation for our members. D) Provide a meeting place for students with similar interests, goals, and backgrounds.

name: Society of Professional Journalists
description: It is the role of journalists to provide this information in an accurate, comprehensive, timely and understandable manner. It is the mission of the Society of Professional Journalists: — To promote this flow of information. — To maintain constant vigilance in protection of the First Amendment guarantees of freedom of speech and of the press. — To stimulate high standards and ethical behavior in the practice of journalism. — To foster excellence among journalists. — To inspire successive generations of talented individuals to become dedicated journalists. — To encourage diversity in journalism.

name: Society of Women Engineers
description: Empower women to achieve their full potential in careers as engineers and leaders; expand the image of the engineering and technology professions as a positive force in improving the quality of life, and demonstrate the value of diversity and inclusion.

name: Society of Women in Business
description: The Society of Women in Business at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign is committed to uniting women and giving them essential skills and experiences to succeed in business.

name: Society of Women in Neuroscience
description: The Society of Women in Neuroscience empowers women to thrive in science through community, mentorship, and purpose. We are committed to supporting one another, giving back, and creating spaces where women in neuroscience feel seen, supported, and inspired to lead.

name: Society of Women In Public Affairs
description: Our mission is to prepare undergraduate women for their future careers in Public Affairs by providing them with a platform to grow as individuals and professionals. Our three core pillars; professionalism, service, and sisterhood provide our diverse cohort of members with various experiences needed to foster their growth. Public Affairs is a large diverse field, so by exposing our members to a range of opportunities and experiences they are better equipped to succeed in the professional world.

name: Sociolinguistics Association at Illinois
description: The mission of SAIL is to create an interdisciplinary intellectual community for students interested in the relationship between language and society. SAIL seeks to connect students across academic levels, departments, methodological traditions, languages, and research interests through sociolinguistic scholarship, research exchange, mentorship, professional development, public engagement, and community building. To fulfill its mission, SAIL shall seek to create meaningful connections among students, researchers, faculty, and other members of the campus community; provide a supportive environm

name: Sociology Student Organization (SSO)
description: SSO is a place for sociology majors, minors, and sociologically curious people to come together academically, socially, and professionally. Our mission is to empower members by providing opportunities for professional development and creating a social support system within our organization. We are driven by the belief that by nurturing students' academic, professional, and personal growth, we can create a powerful future for the world of sociology. We hope to foster an inclusive community with diverse perspectives to work towards a more just and equitable society.

name: South Asian Law Students Association
description: The Mission of SALSA is to promote academic and professional excellence in the legal field, advocate for the interests of its members and South Asian students at the College of Law, raise awareness of legal issues affecting South Asian students, maintain a network of SALSA alumni, provide its members with a valuable support network of friends and resources to help enrich their law school experience, build coalitions with other student organizations and contribute to the University of Illinois community at large, and foster solidarity.

name: South Asian Medical Student Association
description: The South Asian Medical Student Association (SAMoSA) serves to create an inclusive space for South Asian medical students to celebrate their shared heritage, culture, and values. The organization fosters community, cultural appreciation, and professional growth through social, academic, and service-oriented initiatives.

name: Space Law Society
description: The SLS serves as the University of Illinois College of Law student organization dedicated to educating students within the College of Law on the developing field of Space Law. SLS serves to connect students with other Space Law organizations, and further the careers of students in Space Law.

name: Spanish and Portuguese Graduate Organization
description: The purpose(s) of this organization shall be to represent, unify and to meet the needs of the graduate students in the Spanish and Portuguese Department. Organization website: https://publish.illinois.edu/spanportgradorg/

name: SpeakBridge
description: SpeakBridge serves to connect fluent English speakers with students around the world seeking conversational English practice who may lack access to consistent speaking partners. University students volunteering at SpeakBridge will serve through a philanthropy-driven organization, engaging in informative cultural exchanges, playing a role in expanding language education access, and gaining skills in tutoring.

name: Special Olympics Unified Sports UIUC
description: Special Olympics Unified Sports UIUC is an organization that serves to join students and people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) on the same team. It was inspired by a simple principle: training together and playing together is a quick path to friendship and inclusion. Unified partners are college students without intellectual disabilities playing with Special Olympics athletes, individuals with IDD on an equal playing field. Special Olympics Unified Sports also values inclusive leadership, inviting students and Special Olympics athletes to fulfill meaningful roles and le

name: Special Populations' Student Health Concerns Committee
description: SPSHCC is a registered student organization that works closely with the campus, along with community groups and social agencies. The mission of the SPSHCC is to increase general health awareness, improve health status, and promote a change of behavior that will lead to a healthier lifestyle among diverse University of Illinois student populations and the general public. This organization provides students with opportunities to improve their personal/professional skills in team building, public relations, leadership roles, fund raising, program planning, implementation, and evaluation.

name: Special Warfare Club
description: To offer individuals continuous opportunities to develop and hone their technical and interpersonal skills, shaping them into stronger teammates and leaders, while preparing those who choose for the challenges of Special Warfare Selection.

name: Spicy Clamato Improv
description: Spicy Clamato Improv serves as the team for people looking to get involved in improv, specifically in short form improv games (a la “Who’s Line is it Anyway?”). We host comedy shows (regularly themed and costumed!) where we perform our improv. We work to create bonds with each other as a team while also enhancing our comedic abilities and powers. We also foster connections with other improv teams from Illinois through the performances, improv jams, and skill-building workshops of our annual improv comedy festival.

name: Sports & Entertainment Law Society
description: The Sports and Entertainment Law Society (SELS) serves to educate students about the many legal issues that affect the world of sports and entertainment, as well as to provide networking and career opportunities within the sports and entertainment legal industries.

name: Sports Analytics Society
description: At SAS, we engage in a variety of activities aimed at enhancing our members’ understanding and application of sports analytics. This includes organizing insightful workshops, inviting industry experts for guest lectures, and creating opportunities for networking with professionals in the field.

name: Sports and Gaming Project Management
description: the Sports and Gaming Project Management serves as the/to cultivate a network of professionals dedicated to the operational side of the sports and gaming sectors. This RSO exists to provide a space for students to find like-minded peers and collaborate on professional projects. We offer students access to workshops, industry guest speakers, and hands-on initiatives, ensuring that members are the most prepared candidates for project management roles

name: Sprout UIUC
description: Sprout is an organization of students committed to empowering underprivileged students in the surrounding Urbana-Champaign community by providing student-led workshops and seminars regarding personal financial literacy and careers in finance and business. We strive to equip students with the skills and opportunities necessary to pursue higher education whilst also achieving financial success.

name: Squirrel and Bird Watching Club
description: The Squirrel and Bird Watching Club is dedicated to the observation and appreciation of squirrels and birds on the UIUC campus. These important creatures are a vital part of the local ecosystem, and we hope to share our admiration of both these animals within the Squirrel and Bird Watching Club as well as with the university and local community. We believe Squirrel and Bird Watching should be open to all UIUC students, regardless of personal identity or views, and to that end we seek to provide a space for any squirrel or bird enthusiast at UIUC. Included in our mission is the observation and

name: Sri Lankan Cultural Association
description: The Sri Lankan Cultural Association serves to educate and spread awareness to the general public about Sri Lankan culture through informational and celebratory events.

name: Statistics Doctoral Student Association
description: SDSA is an independent student organization governed by the Doctoral students at the Statistics Department at UIUC. The purpose of this Association is to create a suitable ground to foster interdepartmental interaction and collaboration, promote professional development through research presentations, discussions and training, and create a social network by holding various social events among Statistics Doctoral students at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

name: Steel Bridge
description: The Steel Bridge team serves as the way for students to gain hands-on experience of steel design and fabrication.

name: Stiletto Queens
description: Stiletto Queens is a dance team that specializes in dancing in stilettos. Our mission is to provide professional dance instruction and instill an appreciation for the art of stiletto dance in a safe, inclusive environment. We aim to build dance skills, self-confidence, and strength in individuals dancing with stilettos. Although primarily heel dancing, our team also incorporates various dance styles such as modern-day hip-hop, Latin, contemporary, and jazz.

name: Stitching Illini
description: The Stitching Illini serves as a way for students to be involved with crocheting, knitting, and other needle arts as a group.

name: Stop the Bleed UIUC
description: If you’re at the scene of a mass casualty, a bystander at an accident, or at the site of a natural disaster, you may see someone bleeding profusely. The police and the medics are probably at least several minutes away. Unfortunately, they may also be several minutes too late, as bleeding can cause death in less than 5 minutes. The goal of Stop the Bleed UIUC is to provide regular classes to students and the general community about how to stop significant bleeding, providing the skills and confidence to transform bystanders into life-saving first responders.

name: Strengthening and Empowering Educators of Diverse Statuses
description: “They tried to bury us, but they didn’t know we were seeds,” an old Mexican proverb that inspired the start of SEEDS. SEEDS, Strengthening and Empowering Educators of Diverse Statuses, is a student-led organization that focuses on meeting the unique needs of undergraduate students from diverse statuses, including race, ethnicity, gender, age, socio-economic status, disabilities, etc. We strive to create a safe haven in which students are welcome to have an open dialogue about struggles,

name: Structural Engineers Association of Illinois Student Chapter (SEAOI)
description: The Structural Engineers Association of Illinois (SEAOI) Chapter at the University of Illinois aims to connect students in Structural Engineering and Architecture with each other, Alumni, and corporate representatives currently in the industry. We have hosted some of the best engineers in the industry who shared with us their experiences and most challenging projects. The student chapter is in cooperation with the Illinois chapter, SEAOI, which provides students and young engineers many opportunities and resources to connect with other structural engineers at all levels of experience.

name: Student Academy of Audiology
description: The mission of the University of Illinois Chapter of the Student Academy of Audiology is to serve as a collective voice for students within the chapter area and to advance the rights, interests, and welfare of students pursuing careers in audiology. Chapters will engage students in lifelong professional activities that promote and advance the profession of audiology, and provide services, information, education, representation and advocacy for the profession and the public we serve.

name: Student Affairs Sustainability
description: Student Affairs is committed to fostering a sustainable future through proactive engagement in sustainability education and sustainable actions. We advance this mission by implementing and rigorously evaluating our initiatives and nurturing leadership in sustainability. We believe that focusing on creating an inclusive, sustainable future empowers every individual to thrive.

name: Student Aircraft Builders
description: SAB will provide opportunities for member growth by maximizing the learning potential of engineering projects, encouraging personal development, and creating a productive club atmosphere.

name: Student Alumni Ambassadors
description: Student Alumni Ambassadors (SAA) is a student-run organization sponsored by the University of Illinois Alumni Association. SAA’s role on campus is to develop positive relations and interactions among students, alumni, faculty and staff. SAA provides an opportunity for students to realize their fullest potential for involvement and experience while at Illinois. SAA brings together a diverse group of students from the University with a variety of interests, majors and backgrounds. These students work together to spread the enthusiasm, energy and resources of the University of Illinois to alumni

name: Student Art History Association
description: SAHA serves to promote interdisciplinary scholarship and new research that broadens our understanding of the arts.

name: Student Association for Aging Research at Illinois (SAARI)
description: The Student Association for Aging Research at Illinois (SAARI) serves to build an inclusive, interdisciplinary community for students interested in aging and older adult research. As the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign student chapter of the Gerontological Society of America (GSA), SAARI embraces GSA's mission to foster excellence, innovation, and collaboration to advance aging research, education, practice, and policy, and shares its vision of meaningful lives as we age. Through research talks, guest speakers, professional development, conference presentation practice, and informal ne

name: Student Bar Association
description: The Student Bar Association (Association) serves as the representative organization of all students in the College of Law at the University of Illinois. The Association shall serve as the coordinator, organizer, and facilitator of proposals and programs by the students of the College of Law. The Association shall also promote the role of students in the decision-making process relative to the College of Law and those other policy-making bodies whose actions affect the students at the College of Law. The Association shall determine which student organizations shall be recognized within the Coll

name: Student Consortium for Conservation GIS and Remote Sensing
description: The Student Consortium for Conservation GIS and Remote Sensing (SCCGRS) is a student-led network dedicated to fostering the next generation of scholars and practitioners in conservation science, GIS, and remote sensing. We connect students, researchers, and professionals who share a passion for leveraging geospatial technologies to tackle environmental and conservation challenges. SCCGRS is open to anyone interested in conservation, GIS, remote sensing, or environmental science—whether you're an aspiring researcher, a data science enthusiast, or simply someone who is interested in preserving o

name: Student Dietetic Association
description: The University of Illinois chapter of the Student Dietetic Association has been created as a professional group of students that aim to be future Registered Dietitian Nutritionists—and the best in the field, at that. To reach this goal, the members of the club will have the opportunity to travel to professional events, volunteer in nutrition related philanthropy, and network with renowned professionals in the field. Funds for the club will be raised through key sponsorships, collection of dues, and various other fundraising activities, as well as through funding from the University of Illinois

name: Student Engagement
description: Student Engagement supports student leaders through educational development and advisement to achieve their goals and create an involved and sustainable Illinois campus community.

name: Student Media Marketing Association
description: Student Media Marketing association aims to provide the individuals within the organization an environment that fosters creativity and allows them to learn more about media and marketing.

name: Student National Medical Association (SNMA)
description: Student National Medical Association (SNMA) is committed to supporting current and future underrepresented minority medical students, addressing the needs of underserved communities, and increasing the number of clinically excellent, culturally competent and socially conscious physicians. SNMA is a national association, and this organization would serve as the local chapter of SNMA at Carle Illinois College of Medicine at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (CI MED SNMA).

name: Student Nurses' Association
description: Student Nursing Association is dedicated to supporting pre-nursing students in their academic journeys. We provide resources, mentorship, and peer support to help students succeed academically and prepare for nursing careers. Through educational workshops and community engagement, we strive to foster excellence, compassion, and resilience in future healthcare professionals.

Our goal is to promote culture, enhance personal and professional development, maintain a strong focus on service and provide an emphasis on academic excellence in higher education through programming and collaborative events.

name: University YMCA Student Board
description: The University YMCA Student Board serves to foster a relationship and collaboration between Y-RSOs, Y-students, Y-community, and the campus community.

name: Untitled Musical Improv Co
description: The Untitled Musical Improv Co (UMIC) serves as the University of Illinois' school of short-form musical improv. UMIC seeks to educate improvisers with a background in tiered-team style long-form improv and maintain a welcoming, inclusive, passionate, and safe environment to learn and perform musical improv. To successfully coach less experienced musical improvisers, UMIC has its more experienced members lead, teach, and coach its less experienced members through traditions passed down by word of mouth, written word, historical/archival video content, etc. UMIC seeks to utilize a plethora of m

name: UpliftED
description: upliftED is a community of college students dedicated to learning, service, and growth. We create spaces where University of Illinois students can connect with one another, support their own well-being, and become lifelong learners, while using that energy to help underprivileged youth overcome educational hurdles. Through campus events, workshops, and partnerships with schools, social services, and community organizations, we provide essential resources like backpack drives and meal kits, mentorship, and fun, interactive activities. We also host conversations that raise awareness of education

name: Urbana Champaign Student Senators Caucus
description: To serve as a coordinating body for the student senators of the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Campus Senate. The Urbana-Champaign Student Senators Caucus will work to motivate and ensure better student involvement and participation in the Senate and its Committees.

name: Vantage Acquisitions Group
description: The Vantage Acquisitions Group exists to provide students with a rigorous, practitioner-facing experience in mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance, and financial advisory. Vantage members analyze real announced transactions and present their work to industry practitioners for professional-level review. Vantage is guided by three core pillars: Rigor, Excellence, and Elevation. Our mission is to bridge the gap between academic finance and professional practice.

name: Varsity Men's Glee Club at the University of Illinois
description: The purpose of the Varsity Men’s Glee Club is to uphold the tradition of excellence that has been set forth by its members since 1886 by selecting and singing a wide variety of music for men’s voices and sharing and connecting through music with both local and global communities.

name: VAW Global Veterinary Outreach
description: VAW Global Health Alliances develops community health systems while providing interns the opportunity to work alongside experienced local healthcare professionals. VAW Global Veterinary Interns work closely with community partners to implement veterinary clinics, as well as provide assistance to existing animal shelters, across low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). In the Veterinary Outreach program, interns learn about healthcare in a global context. Through shadowing local veterinarians, interns will also learn about veterinary procedures, treatment courses, clinic operations, vaccinatio

name: Velocity Dance
description: The primary purpose of Velocity Dance is to bring together dancers with different dance backgrounds to perform together as a team.

name: Venture Capital Association
description: The Venture Capital Association’s purpose is to provide students interested in venture capital with exposure to the industry through education as well as real-world experience. VC funds leverage the organization’s resources for consultancy on both potential and existing investments. In order to provide value to our partners, VCA analysts must be trained on how to think like an investor, perform analysis, and produce high-quality deliverables. Analysts are formally trained in their first semester through a bootcamp phase by the Membership Director on a curriculum specifically designed for VCA,

name: Veterinarians as One Inclusive Community for Empowerment
description: The purpose of VOICE is: To increase awareness, respect and sensitivity to differences among all individuals and communities in the field of veterinary medicine These include, but are not limited to, sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/reassignment, gender expression, citizenship, pregnancy or parental status, veteran or military status, and educational background To celebrate diversity within the profession of veterinary medicine and provide a campus environment that embraces diversity and promo

name: Video Game Music Club
description: The VGMC serves as the place for students to share their interest in video game music (VGM). Members will socialize within our discord and at events. We also aim to create ensembles to share/perform VGM around the Champaign-Urbana area. If you are interested here is the discord server: https://discord.gg/evKz48XbjF

name: Vietnamese Families and Students Community at UIUC
description: VFS helps international students at UIUC, particularly those arriving from Vietnam, and their families adjust to academic and daily life in Champaign-Urbana. It supports newcomers through peer mentoring, practical guidance on topics such as housing, transportation, banking, and navigating campus resources, and connections with students who have already made the transition. VFS also builds a close-knit community for students who are far from home, including graduate and professional students with spouses and children, through shared meals, holiday gatherings, and family-friendly events. Members

name: Vietnamese Student Association
description: The Vietnamese Student Association is an organization dedicated to promoting cultural awareness through a variety of events on campus and in the Urbana-Champaign community. VSA strives to establish a supportive environment for those of Vietnamese and non-Vietnamese descent to interact and engage in activities that preserve and appreciate the Vietnamese culture and heritage. VSA is open to everyone that is interested in learning or sharing Vietnamese culture.

name: Virtual Reality Club at UIUC
description: The purpose of the VR Club at UIUC is to aid club members in learning about and having fun with VR by hosting opportunities to play, explore, and learn. Opportunities we host are broken up into the following 3 categories and overlap as such: VRClub, MiXR, VR eSports. We host open hours weekly to play exciting VR games and meet new people. Our themed open hours feature a new specific VR experience or game every week for everyone to try out. We decide the specific event for open hours weekly so there is always something new for people to try out. MiXR (Meetings involving Extended Reality) is an

name: Vis-A-Vis Tutoring
description: Vis-A-Vis Tutoring serves to provide an opportunity for enthusiastic and dedicated University of Illinois students to tutor children one-on-one or be a classroom aide in the local Champaign-Urbana elementary, middle, and high schools. Providing tutors and aides helps teachers and schools facing difficult classroom environments or managing limited resources. Email: askvisavis@gmail.com

name: Vitality Dance Team
description: TO UPHOLD THE NAME AND REPUTATION OF VITALITY DANCE TEAM FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ILLINOIS WHILE CREATING A SAFE SPACE TO DANCE AND BOND WITH OTHER MEMBERS OF GREEK LIFE.

name: Volta: Battery Manufacturing at Illinois
description: To develop industry skills through a project to create functional lithium-ion cell that matches a reference cell in capacity and cycle life

name: Volunteer Illini Projects
description: Volunteer Illini Projects, Inc. (VIP) is a student-run, student-staffed volunteer organization committed to peace, unity and change. By working with and within the community, VIP makes a positive impact through service, thereby enriching students’ educational experiences and committing students to a lifetime of volunteerism. VIP strives to foster unity and enhance interpersonal connections through mutual understanding and empowerment. The dynamic tradition of past student initiative and vision for positive social action guides the future of Volunteer Illini Projects, Inc.

name: Walking Illini
description: The Walking Illini serves as a way to enjoy the leisure aspect of walking and to connect with other students at the University. During walks, members can get to know one another and make new friends. There will also be a variety of socials that allow students to bond in new and fun ways.

name: weDignify-UIUC
description: weDignify-UIUC’s purpose is to promote and defend the dignity of all human life, from conception to natural death. We envision college campuses to be centers for a culture of life where people treat life with love, new life is welcomed with joy, and people suffering from abortion are led to healing hope.

name: Wesley Foundation Student Fellowship
description: The Wesley Student Center is a theologically progressive, inclusive, and affirming campus ministry offering space for students to meet new people, explore faith, and engage in social justice as we transform our lives, our community, and the world!

name: What You Will Theatre Company
description: What You Will Theatre Company presents the works of William Shakespeare, his contemporaries, and other relevant productions in a humanistic and accessible light. Through student-produced Shakespeare we are there to provide a bridge between the Early Modern period and today’s contemporary audiences by entertaining as well as challenging our audiences to explore inner truths of humanity and of themselves.

name: Women for Afghan Women
description: Women for Afghan Women at University of Illinois Urbana Champaign (WAW) serves to raise money for its mother organization, a grassroots organization dedicated to empowering Afghan women and children in Afghanistan. Through numerous fundraising and awareness events, WAW at Illinois will work to challenge societal norms, address gender-based violence, and advance gender equality.

name: Women Impacting Supply Chain Excellence
description: The mission of WISE is to empower students interested in studying or pursuing a career in supply chain management through networking, personal and professional development, leadership skills, and industry knowledge.

name: Women in Aerospace
description: WIA serves to promote and maintain women's interests in the field of aerospace engineering. WIA also aims to provide a supportive resource for current and prospective female aerospace engineers and foster a sense of community for women in the aerospace engineering department here at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign through social, professional, and networking events. WIA is also a chapter of the Women of Aeronautics and Astronautics (WoAA) committee within the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA) but maintains internal independence.

name: Women In Architecture-UIUC
description: The mission of Women in Architecture (WIA) is to cultivate and promote the development and leadership of women design professionals by providing a forum for empowering, networking, and mentoring to enhance the architectural community. Though we are a student organization, we also connect with the larger organizations in Chicago to present different networking opportunities with working professionals.

name: Women in Chemical Sciences
description: WiCS Exists to: (1) Provide a community designed specifically focussed on inclusion and support for those who identify as women within the school of chemical sciences (2) Provide professional development and support for advancement of members including but not-limited to mentorship, interaction and exposure to research topics and job opportunities. (3) Prepare women for the difficulties often encountered in male-dominated workplaces and academic environments. Provide an ongoing and active alumni network to maintain a support structure for current and former student (4) Advance efforts of inclu

name: Women in Civil and Environmental Engineering
description: The Women in CEE RSO empowers tomorrow’s innovators in the field of civil and environmental engineering. It provides professional, academic, and social support to unite women and non-male-identifying individuals in civil and environmental engineering. It is dedicated to creating an inclusive community by collaborating with industry leaders and educational institutions. We aim to create positive change and create an environment where everyone can succeed.

name: Women in Computer Science
description: Women in Computer Science (WCS) nonprofit dedicated to supporting the efforts of young women and non-binary people pursuing careers in CS or show interests in technology. We aim to provide professional development, mentoring opportunities, and a safe and inclusive community on those historically underrepresented in Computer Science.

name: Women In CyberSecurity Student Chapter
description: Women in CyberSecurity (WiCyS) is a student chapter of a larger non-profit national organization dedicated to bringing together women in cybersecurity from academia, research and industry to share knowledge, experience, networking and mentoring. This RSO helps women interested in cyber security through tech talks, workshops, networking opportunities, research, conferences, and leadership opportunities. Our members are given the opportunity to attend the annual WiCyS National Conference and network with companies and fellow students passionate about the field of cyber security. WiCyS aims to pr

name: Women in Data Science Urbana-Champaign
description: Women in Data Science (WiDS) works to cultivate the next generation of Data Science and AI leaders by providing resources for upskilling, networking, mentorship, and growth opportunities.

name: Women in Electrical and Computer Engineering
description: We are WECE, the Women in Electrical and Computer Engineering - a student organization at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign dedicated to supporting women within the Illinois ECE department. We welcome members of all genders to be active in the group, and we strive to build communities amongst ourselves by hosting social, technical, outreach, and professional events!

name: Women in Mechanical Science and Engineering
description: Women in Mechanical Science and Engineering (WIM) aims to provide an inclusive and open social community for women and gender minorities within the Department of Mechanical Science and Engineering at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. WIM strives to increase the growth and leadership of women and gender minorities within the department and provide professional, social, and academic resources to its members.

name: Women in Medicine
description: Women in Medicine (WiM) serves to empower women medical students at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign by promoting leadership, mentorship, and community. WiM promotes women’s health and gender equity in medicine through education, advocacy, and programming that addresses disparities and supports future physicians.

name: Women in Music
description: Our mission as an RSO is to support women majoring in music at UIUC and provide opportunities for those women and their supporters.

name: Women in Nuclear Student Chapter at the University of Illinois
description: The purpose of the University of Illinois Women in Nuclear Student Chapter is to provide students with opportunities to learn about nuclear science, participate in educational outreach programs, professionally develop its members, and advocacy.

name: Women in Psychology
description: The purpose of Women in Psychology - UIUC [WIP] is to empower people in the psychology and psychology-adjacent fields. We want to bring together students with similar interests to learn more about psychology and the many possibilities a psychology degree holds.

name: Women of Color
description: Women of Color is dedicated to educating, uplifting, and uniting minority women at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and throughout the greater Champaign-Urbana community. Through community building, cultural programming, and opportunities for learning and collaboration, we strive to create a supportive space where women of color feel seen, valued, and empowered. Each year, our Women of Color Annual Conference brings together women for workshops, keynote speakers, and engaging activities that encourage personal growth, celebrate diverse identities, and foster meaningful connections.

name: Women's Glee Club
description: The purpose(s) of this organization shall be to rehearse and perform various treble repertoire. Additionally, the purpose is to conduct social activities.

name: Women's Resources Center (WRC)
description: Since its founding in 2009, the Women’s Resources Center has been committed to supporting women students, while catalyzing the development of their personal and professional selves. Staff are committed to supporting and actualizing liberation in all aspects of the Center’s work, striving for greater equity, retention, advancement, and empowerment of women students, staff, and faculty.

name: Women's Undergraduate Law Society
description: The purpose of the Women’s Undergraduate Law Society is to provide an environment/organization for prospective women lawyers. Concerns of women applying for law school, as well as concerns for professional careers will be discussed regarding how we can make an impact in the law field. Create a welcoming environment for women interested in exploring the legal field.

name: WPGU-FM 107.1
description: The purpose(s) of this organization shall be to train the broadcasters and media professionals of the future.

name: Wrapsody Dance Co.
description: Wrapsody Dance Company serves as a creative dance company on campus that creates a space for women and men to express themselves through different dance styles to promote confidence. We want to empower individuals who feel they have no other voice to use dance as their voice to speak. Our goal is to ensure that our dances tell stories of the unheard. We also want to ensure that there is a space on campus for dancers who feel that they do not belong in any category of dance simply just want to move as an art form.

name: Wrestling Club at University of Illinois
description: The Wrestling Club will be a club open to all, despite varied wrestling experiences from zero formal training to a former state champion. As a club, our purpose is to safely and properly provide the space to members and teach wrestlers various techniques, awarnesses, and the rules of the sport while avoiding a hostile environment. We will mostly operate under intrasquad competition, but will keep our minds open to the expansion of our competition, beyond the club itself.

name: Written Arts and Media Club
description: We're a club geared towards supporting aspiring media creators of all types and fostering a community of creatives!

name: X-Time at UIUC
description: X-Time UIUC empowers the next generation by expanding access to STEAM education for youth in the community and beyond. Through hands-on activities, cross-disciplinary collaboration, and outreach led by UIUC students from diverse majors, we inspire curiosity, creativity, and confidence.

name: Xtension Chords A Cappella
description: The purpose(s) of Xtension Chords A Cappella is to serve as an all-male competitive a cappella group and perform for various organizations on and off campus.

name: Yarn & Unity
description: Our purpose is to create a community for Black/African/African American students to learn, practice, and teach each other about different yarn centered crafts. This organization is dedicated to ensuring it is a welcoming and safe space to those who seek to learn and create with yarn.

name: Young Americans for Liberty
description: The purpose of Young Americans for Liberty is to spread the ideas of liberty at the University of Illinois. Through education and mobilization, we will defend the rights of students on this campus from overreach.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America
description: We work closely with Champaign-Urbana Democratic Socialists of America (CU DSA) to foster political engagement among youth in the Champaign-Urbana area, especially those attending the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC). UIUC YDSA shall organize campus and community rallies, host talks on a variety of political, social and economic topics, engage in community service, and facilitate grassroots organization in support of just and equitable society. Within and throughout this struggle, we will articulate and defend the idea that true human liberation is impossible under capitalism.

name: Yu-Gi-Oh Illini
description: The Yu-Gi-Oh Illini serves as place to allow students to meet a group of like-minded individuals who share an interest/hobby in the Yu-Gi-Oh trading card game, as well as a place to participate in and create events for the game. The Yu-Gi-Oh Illini aims to promote a positive and fun environment for all who wish to enjoy the shared interest.

name: Zamo Illini
description: Zamo Illini is a subchapter of the Zamorano Alumni Association–United States (AGEAP-USA) in the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. Zamorano is a Pan-American university in Honduras focused on agronomy, food science, agribusiness and agroenvironment. Zamo Illini’s mission is to support the professional development of Zamorano alumni pursuing graduate studies or research positions at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, and of current Zamorano students who come to the University of Illinois as interns or visiting scholars, and to promote networking between them and the students, fa

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. Nu Delta Chapter
description: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated strives to be a community-conscious, action-oriented organization dedicated to fostering positive relationships amongst women and the community. Our five Triumphant Founders had a vision to form a sorority which would "directly affect positive change, chart a course of action for the 1920s and beyond, raise people's consciousness, encourage the highest standards of scholastic achievement" and so much more. Our current chapter, the Nu Delta Chapter, strives to carry out this mission on a localized campus/community level.

name: Zeta Psi Fraternity
description: The primary purpose of the fraternity shall be to aid and encourage its student members to achieve that development of character, intellect, and leadership, and that capacity for human relationships which are commensurate with the highest aims and purpose of university education at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign; and, generally, the fraternity shall form a lifelong bond of brotherhood, as devoted to the fulfillment of the ideals expressed in the ritual and to the fellowship of its members.

name: Zindaa UIUC
description: Zindaa UIUC serves to spread Indian culture and our passion for dance.
